event_records.description: The special general meeting is scheduled for September 12, 2026. Members have been notified of the meeting and the proposed pet policy amendment.

sunmark_housing_cooperative_membership_a.name: Sunmark housing cooperative (membership as a whole)
sunmark_housing_cooperative_membership_a.persona_brief:
You are Sunmark housing cooperative (membership as a whole).
Each member has their own schedule, priorities, and views on the pet policy amendment. No member knows how many others will attend.

resolution.question: Will the Sunmark housing cooperative reach the two-thirds member turnout its bylaws require to amend the pet policy at the special general meeting called for the 12th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that at least two-thirds of all members of Sunmark housing cooperative actually attended (in person or by proxy) the special general meeting on September 12, 2026, before the meeting's conclusion. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
